# Chalet Jostedalen - Holiday Rental

> High-end triplex chalet in Saint-Sorlin d'Arves (Savoie, French Alps), at the foot of Les Sybelles ski area (310 km of runs). 240 m2, 6 bedrooms, jacuzzi, for 8 to 15 guests.

## General information

- Nom : Chalet Jostedalen
- Type : Seasonal rental (mountain chalet)
- Adresse : Saint-Sorlin d'Arves, 73530, Savoie, France
- Altitude : 1600 m
- Site web : https://www.location-chalet-jostedalen.com/en/
- Telephone : +33 6 51 31 11 69
- Contact : https://goo.gl/forms/bAMhK9uY5H

## Capacity

- Surface : 240 m2
- Chambres : 6
- Capacite : 8 a 15 personnes
- Type : Triplex
- Orientation : South
- Vues : Ski slopes and mountains

## Rooms

- 6 bedrooms
- 2 living rooms
- 1 large entrance hall
- 1 relaxation room with spa/jacuzzi (5-6 seats)
- 5 showers
- 5 toilets (3 separate)
- Private garage for 1 car

## Kitchen equipment

- Dishwasher

## Multimedia and linen

- Wifi
- Telephone

## Baby equipment

## Nearby and activities

- Ski slopes at 200 m
- Free shuttle at 30 m
- Les Sybelles ski area: 310 km of runs (4th largest in France)
- Supervised lake at 200 m (summer)
- Garden with table and barbecue (summer)
- Hiking, climbing, horse riding, via ferrata
